text: bianji 是面向 DSH 桌面端的工作区编辑器插件，在右侧栏注册独立编辑器标签，并通过会话工作区浏览文件。用户可以查看文件树、打开文本文件进行编辑，使用 Markdown 预览，也可查看图片、音视频、PDF 和 Office 文档的只读预览。文本改动通过 DSH 文件服务保存，适合需要在对话旁查看和修改当前项目文件的用户；不需要额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

bianji is a DSH workspace editor in the right sidebar. It browses the active session workspace, opens and edits text files, previews Markdown, and provides read-only previews for media, PDF, and Office files. Changes are saved through DSH file services. No API key or external account is required.
想在 DSH 对话旁边浏览和编辑当前工作区里的文件
I want a file tree and text editor beside my DSH conversation
能不能在 DSH 里预览 Markdown 和常见文档，不用切换到别的应用？
bianji 的功能「工作区文件编辑」：在右侧编辑器标签中浏览当前会话的工作区、打开文本文件并修改；编辑内容通过 DSH 文件服务提交保存。
bianji 的功能「文件预览」：打开 Markdown 可切换源码与预览，也能查看图片、音视频、PDF 及 docx、pptx、xlsx 的只读预览。
bianji 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 16；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

bianji README · Introduction：

bianji · 工作区编辑器

在对话旁编辑文件，让草稿与工作区保持连贯。

DeepSeek Harness 桌面端右侧栏的文件树、Monaco 编辑与 Markdown 预览。

简体中文 · English

v0.1.6 · MIT · DSH desktop plugin

核心能力 · 工作方式 · 快速开始 · 保存与边界 · 验证

bianji README · Introduction：---

面向个人桌面工作流的文件编辑插件，可供参考，不建议未经核对直接照搬到其他 DSH 版本。它保留独立 `kind: bianji`，不替换官方文件面板，也不是 macOS 原生 Edit 菜单。已针对本机桌面 **0.2.2-alpha.2** 核对。

bianji README · 核心能力：
🗂 工作区文件树

从当前会话解析工作区，浏览文件并在右侧打开；不为读取历史会话启动 Agent。默认隐藏 node_modules / .git，可过滤文件名。		 ✍️ 文本与预览

Monaco 编辑、受限 Markdown 预览；图片/音视频/PDF 只读查看；docx/pptx/xlsx 抽文本或表格预览。不在此编辑二进制或 Office 原件。		 🧾 版本保护

读取版本并使用官方 replaceIfVersion 保存，冲突暂停自动保存而不丢弃草稿。
🔗 对话引用

右键添加到对话、复制路径、访达打开，或拖到输入框插入 @引用。		 💾 独立自动保存

逐文件安排保存，在途输入保留最新草稿；失败或冲突可复制本地内容后重载。		 🛡 会话策略

读写限定在当前工作区，并复用官方文件服务和该会话的沙箱权限。

bianji README · 工作方式：工作区优先来自 live Agent；已 attached、无 Agent 的 Session 走 `sessions.get`；冷历史走官方 `sessionQuery.observeSession`（`projectionMode: "none"`，读完即 dispose）。旧 Host 若仍有 `sessionController.inspect` 则作为兜底。保存重新解析权限，经官方文件服务及版本锁执行；不是由 Client 直接写任意磁盘路径。

bianji README · 快速开始：需要 DeepSeek Harness 官方桌面端及与其 API 兼容的环境。源码是桌面文件系统插件，不是独立网页应用。按 **profile bundle** 加载，不要再往 desktop `cordis.patch.yml` insert 同一 id。

```sh
export DSH_HOME="${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}"
git clone https://github.com/yueyexiayu/dsh-bianji.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/bianji"
```

1. `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"bianji": "link:$DSH_HOME/plugins/bianji"`
2. 同一文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 加字符串 `"bianji"`
3. 在该 profile 目录安装依赖，确认 `node_modules/bianji` 链到插件目录
bianji README · 快速开始：**⌘Q 完全退出 DSH 后重开**，展开右侧栏，在「开始」中打开「编辑器」。更新源码不等于正在运行的 Host 已重载。

bianji README · 保存与边界：- 读写限制在当前会话工作区 `cwd` 内。缺少 sessionId / 绝对 cwd（含相对 cwd）返回 400，未知会话 404，缺少检查服务 503，持久化读取或损坏错误 500；不会用空工作区掩盖错误。
- 严格 UTF-8：二进制、GBK 等非 UTF-8 及过大文件明确拒绝。不删除 BOM，不自动转换编码或换行；保存拒绝 NUL、孤立 surrogate 和不支持的控制字节。
- POSIX 文件名中的 `\` 保持原义；路径和真实目标需处于工作区内。检查能拒绝已复现的 symlink 替换越界，不是内核级原子隔离。
- 冷历史使用未发布的 `sessions.prepare` 快照恢复该会话的权限，不 create/resume Agent，不继承 Host 的宽松权限。缺少策略或文件版本服务时拒绝保存。
- 外部改写、替换或删除会使旧版本保存冲突；不重建已删除文件。冲突保留草稿，重新加载需确认丢弃未保存内容；保存失败时关闭标签不会丢稿。
- 重载期间锁定保存与关闭，读取期间继续编辑会取消过期结果。草稿在客户端内存中按会话保留，**刷新客户端、完全退出或停用插件后不保留**，请先保存或复制。
- 版本检查与官方 AI 文件工具共用实例/写入锁，但不是操作系统跨进程条件写入；其他编辑器仍可能恰好在检查后、替换前写入。
- Markdown 仅生成转义后的受限标签和 HTTP(S) 链接，不执行原始 HTML。访达启动和目录请求失败会明确显示。保存/访达请求与目录读取一样 15 秒超时。
- 不包含安装器、账号或凭据。

bianji README · 验证：```sh cd "$DSH_HOME/plugins/bianji" for file in lib/*.js; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done node --test ``` 测试可能跳过缺少官方安装包/浏览器环境的项；跳过不能计为通过。
官方文件服务与浏览器测试说明 安装包内的真实文件服务回归只创建临时文件，不修改官方包： ```sh BIANJI_OFFICIAL_RUNTIME='/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar/dsh' \ ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 '/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness' \ --test test/official-fs.test.mjs ```

bianji README · 验证：也可在普通 Node 中以 `BIANJI_OFFICIAL_RUNTIME` 指向只读解包参考。`test/client-security.test.mjs` 需要实际 Playwright、React/ReactDOM 18 UMD 和匹配的 Chromium headless shell；配置键为 `BIANJI_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE`、`BIANJI_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE`、`BIANJI_REACT_UMD`、`BIANJI_REACT_DOM_UMD`。不要用用户 Chrome 或完整 Chrome.app 冒充无窗口验收。

bianji README · 验证：2026-10-29 对照本机桌面 **0.2.2-alpha.2**：官方 `SessionController.inspect` 已不存在，冷历史改为 `sessionQuery.observeSession`。单元测试 87 通过；官方 Electron 集成 20 通过。浏览器 XSS 用例在本机未安装 Playwright/React UMD 时跳过，不能计为通过。这不等于已 ⌘Q 重开后的桌面端到端可见性验收。

</details>

bianji README · 更新与许可：更新前保存内存草稿；卸载从 desktop `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 去掉 `bianji`，不要清空整份 patch。然后完全重启 DSH。仓库不包含账号、凭据或通用安装器。源码采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。

bianji README · Introduction：

bianji · Workspace editor

Edit beside the conversation. Keep your workspace and drafts connected.

A file tree, Monaco editing and Markdown preview in the DeepSeek Harness desktop sidebar.

简体中文 · English

v0.1.6 · MIT · DSH desktop plugin

Features · How it works · Quick start · Saving and boundaries · Validation

bianji README · Introduction：---

A desktop plugin tailored to a personal workflow. Treat it as a reference and verify compatibility before copying it to another DSH version. It keeps its own `kind: bianji`, does not replace the official file panel and is not the native macOS Edit menu. Checked against desktop **0.2.2-alpha.2**.

bianji README · Features：
🗂 Workspace tree

Resolve files from the current session and open them beside the conversation, without starting an Agent to inspect history. Hides node_modules / .git by default and can filter by filename.		 ✍️ Editing and preview

Monaco and a restricted Markdown preview. Images, audio, video and PDF open read-only; docx/pptx/xlsx show extracted text or a table glance. Binary and Office originals are not saved here.		 🧾 Version-aware writes

Read a version and save through the official replaceIfVersion service. Conflicts pause autosave, not discard drafts.
🔗 Conversation references

Add to chat, copy a path, reveal in Finder or drag into the composer as an @reference.		 💾 Per-file autosave

Preserve newer edits during in-flight saves; copy local content before reloading a failed or conflicted file.		 🛡 Session policy

Constrain operations to the workspace and reuse official filesystem

bianji README · How it works：The workspace comes from a live Agent first; an attached Session without an Agent uses `sessions.get`; cold history uses official `sessionQuery.observeSession` (`projectionMode: "none"`, disposed after the read). Older hosts that still expose `sessionController.inspect` remain a fallback. Saving resolves policy again and uses the official filesystem and version lock—not direct arbitrary disk writes from the Client.

bianji README · Quick start：Requires the official DeepSeek Harness desktop application and compatible APIs. This is a desktop filesystem plugin, not a standalone web application. Load it as a **profile bundle**; do not also insert the same id in desktop `cordis.patch.yml`.

```sh
export DSH_HOME="${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}"
git clone https://github.com/yueyexiayu/dsh-bianji.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/bianji"
```

bianji README · Quick start：1. Add `"bianji": "link:$DSH_HOME/plugins/bianji"` to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json` `dependencies`
2. Add the string `"bianji"` to the same file's `dsh.profile.bundles`
3. Install that profile's dependencies and confirm `node_modules/bianji` links to the plugin

**Quit DSH fully with ⌘Q and reopen it.** Open the editor from the sidebar's start page. Updating files does not prove the running Host has reloaded them.

bianji README · Saving and boundaries：- Reads and writes stay inside the session workspace `cwd`. Missing sessionId / absolute cwd (including relative cwd) returns 400; unknown session 404; unavailable inspection 503; corrupt history 500. Errors do not become an empty workspace.
- Strict UTF-8: binary, non-UTF-8 input such as GBK, and oversized files fail explicitly. BOM and line endings are preserved. Saves reject NUL, lone surrogates and unsupported control bytes.
- POSIX backslashes remain filename characters. Paths and actual targets must remain inside the workspace. Checks reject reproduced symlink-replacement escapes, but are not kernel-level atomic isolation.
- Cold history uses an unpublished `sessions.prepare` snapshot to restore its permissions, without creating/resuming an Agent or inheriting permissive Host policy. Missing policy/version services deny saves.
- External writes, replacement or deletion conflict with an old version. Deleted files are not recreated. Drafts survive conflict and failed saves; reloading requires confirmation before discarding local edits.
- Reloading locks save/close; editing during a read cancels obsolete reload results. Per-session drafts li

bianji README · Validation：```sh cd "$DSH_HOME/plugins/bianji" for file in lib/*.js; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done node --test ``` Tests may skip unavailable installed-runtime/browser environments. A skip is not a pass.
Official filesystem and browser test notes The installed-runtime integration creates temporary files and does not modify the official package:

bianji README · Validation：```sh
BIANJI_OFFICIAL_RUNTIME='/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar/dsh' \
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 '/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness' \
  --test test/official-fs.test.mjs
```

bianji README · Validation：Ordinary Node can also use `BIANJI_OFFICIAL_RUNTIME` pointing to a read-only extracted reference. `test/client-security.test.mjs` requires Playwright, React/ReactDOM 18 UMD and a matching Chromium headless shell, configured by `BIANJI_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE`, `BIANJI_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE`, `BIANJI_REACT_UMD` and `BIANJI_REACT_DOM_UMD`. Do not substitute the user's Chrome or a full Chrome.app for windowless validation.

bianji README · Validation：On 2026-10-29 against desktop **0.2.2-alpha.2**, `SessionController.inspect` is gone and cold history uses `sessionQuery.observeSession`. Unit tests: 87 passed. Official Electron integration: 20 passed. Browser XSS cases skipped here without Playwright/React UMD and are not a pass. This is not end-to-end proof that the latest desktop Host was reloaded with ⌘Q.

</details>

bianji README · Updates and license：Save in-memory drafts before updating. Uninstall by removing `bianji` from the desktop profile `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`; do not empty the whole patch. Then fully restart DSH. This repository includes no account credentials or general installer. Source is [MIT-licensed](LICENSE).
